Sam R.: quick flag sync oddity while rolling `gateway_routing_v2`. console shows active=2 but a tiny fraction of nodes still serve v0. noticed around 02:14 UTC.
Kai L.: can you paste a sample trace or headers?
Sam R.: sample from edge logs: If-None-Match: W/\"v0-17\" -> 304; client kept local v0. server /internal/flags returns v2 with ETag W/\"v2-91\" and header X-Flag-Nonce: 91. proxy returned 304 and stripped X-Flag-Nonce.
Dana M.: aha. proxies dropping diagnostics headers on 304. we added X-Flag-Nonce in last console rollout to help sequencing. client only compares ETag.
ops-bot: alert: flag-sync-drift(gateway_routing_v2)=0.0005 -> INC-5241
Kai L.: proposal: 1) edge-client: on 304, if any debug header present compare local nonce -> if mismatch, fetch full payload. 2) proxy: preserve X-Flag-Nonce and X-Flag-Seq on 304 responses. 3) metrics: emit flag.sync.304_check and flag.sync.mismatch(tags=env,flag,region). 4) console: small \"sync status\" chip next to flags (hidden behind console.feature.sync_health). 5) safety: console.safemode.pause_on_mismatch default true for critical flags.
Sam R.: tests: unit for 304->GET path, integration synthetic that toggles nonce and ensures clients converge within 10s. include backward compatibility if proxy lacks headers.
Dana M.: ops runbook temporary:
```
# quick probe
curl -sI https://edge-proxy.eu.internal/flags/gateway_routing_v2 | egrep -i 'ETag|X-Flag-Nonce|X-Flag-Seq' || true
# if headers missing -> deploy proxy passthrough or restart
```
Kai L.: rollout plan: land client fallback and proxy passthrough, canary ap-southeast-1 10% for 20m, monitor flag.sync.mismatch and overall error budget. alert triggers: region rate >0.05% over 10m or global >0.01% over 15m. if matched, auto-pause rollout and page owners.
Sam R.: I'll open the client PR with tests and a small integration harness. Dana, can you patch the proxy?
Dana M.: will queue proxy change and add a nightly scanner that checks header passthrough across regions.
ops-bot: deployment canary started: edge-client v1.17.2 -> ap-southeast-1 (10%)
Kai L.: UX will mock the sync chip and drop in #product. keep it minimal.
Sam R.: thanks all, i'll follow up with telemetry after 24h. :thumbsup:
